blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A short and clear reply is worth a lot. Short email replies save time for everyone. A good reply says thanks, confirms the plan, adds the file, and closes in a warm way.

Today we collect five useful phrases. You will use them again and again. "Thanks for your email." "I confirm the meeting on Monday." "Please find the file attached."

Take your time. Every sentence counts. You do not need long words. A few clear lines are enough.

items.q: What is the text about?
items.why: O texto fala de respostas de email curtas e claras.

items.q: According to the text, a good reply does all of these EXCEPT…
items.why: "You do not need long words." Um bom email é curto e simples.

items.q: Why are short replies good?
items.why: "Short email replies save time for everyone."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: A short reply can be clear and useful.
You should write long emails to sound professional.
"Thanks for your email" is a useful phrase.
A few clear lines are enough.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende o email curto — a ideia de escrever email longo vai contra isso.

items.q: "Take your time. Every sentence counts." suggests that…
options: you should write fast and not think
each line matters, so write with care
items.why: Inferência: "every sentence counts" mostra que cada frase é importante — escreva com cuidado.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver praticando respostas de email. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, I am Oliver. I work at Czarnikow. Let me show you how I reply to a short email.

This morning I got a message from Maria. She sent me the report. So my reply is easy. I write: "Thanks for your email. I received the report, thank you." Short and clear.

Next, she asked about the meeting. I write: "I confirm the meeting on Monday." Now she knows the day. She does not need to ask again.

Then I need to send a file. I write: "Please find the file attached." And I add the file. I always check the file is there before I click send.

Maria also had a question. I do not know the answer yet. So I write: "Good question. I will check and reply soon." That is honest and kind.

At the end I close in a warm way. I write: "Let me know if you need more. Best regards, Oliver." That is it. My reply is short, but it says everything.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who sent Oliver an email this morning?
items.why: "This morning I got a message from Maria."

items.q: What did Maria send Oliver?
items.why: "She sent me the report."

items.q: What does Oliver do BEFORE he clicks send?
options: He checks the file is there
items.why: "I always check the file is there before I click send."

items.q: Why does Oliver write "Good question. I will check and reply soon."?
options: He does not know the answer yet
He does not want to help
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "I do not know the answer yet", por isso promete verificar e responder depois.

items.q: How would you best describe Oliver's replies?
items.why: Inferência: ele usa frases curtas, confirma tudo e fecha de forma calorosa.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Thanks for your reply." What does thanks mean?
items.why: Thanks = obrigado. Usamos para agradecer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Please find the file ___."
items.why: Attached = anexo. "Please find the file attached" é uma frase pronta.

items.q: "I confirm the meeting on Monday." To confirm means to…
items.why: Confirm = confirmar, dizer que está certo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Good ___ — I will check and reply soon."
items.why: Question = dúvida/pergunta. "Good question" é uma resposta comum.

items.q: "I received the report, thanks." To receive means to…
items.why: Receive = receber, ou seja, ter recebido algo que foi enviado.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em emails de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I will get back to you soon." This means…
options: I will reply to you later
items.why: Get back to you = responder / dar retorno depois.

items.q: "Please let me know if you need more." This means…
options: tell me if you need more
items.why: Let me know = me avise / me diga.

items.q: "Noted, thank you." When you write "Noted", you mean…
options: I saw it and I understand
items.why: Noted = anotado / entendido. Você viu a mensagem e registrou.

items.q: "I will look into your question." This means…
items.why: Look into = investigar, verificar algo.

items.q: "Feel free to reach out any time." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato, procurar alguém.
